payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the dataset collection process, including the number of questions, the categorization method, and the annotation process.

claims.text: The dataset was constructed to include 7,787 science exam questions organized into a fine-grained hierarchical taxonomy of 406 problem domains.
Two annotators, including a lead annotator with professional domain expertise, annotated the entire dataset to ensure quality and consistency.
Questions from the training, development, and test sets were randomly shuffled to counterbalance learning effects during annotation.
